title: A radiomics model from joint FDG-PET and MRI texture features for the prediction of lung metastases in soft-tissue sarcomas of the extremities

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《A radiomics model from joint FDG-PET and MRI texture features for the prediction of lung metastases in soft-tissue sarcomas of the extremities》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】This study aims at developing a joint FDG-PET and MRI texture-based model for the early evaluation of lung metastasis risk in soft-tissue sarcomas (STSs).

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】We investigate if the creation of new composite textures from the combination of FDG-PET and MR imaging information could better identify aggressive tumours.

evidence.text: This study aims at developing a joint FDG-PET and MRI texture-based model for the early evaluation of lung metastasis risk in soft-tissue sarcomas (STSs).
We investigate if the creation of new composite textures from the combination of FDG-PET and MR imaging information could better identify aggressive tumours.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《A radiomics model from joint FDG-PET and MRI texture features for the prediction of lung metastases in soft-tissue sarcomas of the extremities》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】Towards this goal, a cohort of 51 patients with histologically proven STSs of the extremities was retrospectively evaluated.

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】All patients had pre-treatment FDG-PET and MRI scans comprised of T1-weighted and T2-weighted fat-suppression sequences (T2FS).

evidence.text: Towards this goal, a cohort of 51 patients with histologically proven STSs of the extremities was retrospectively evaluated.
All patients had pre-treatment FDG-PET and MRI scans comprised of T1-weighted and T2-weighted fat-suppression sequences (T2FS).
